evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked directly; call opened with rate-shopping/availability comparison instead.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer asked repeatedly about what packing/wrapping is included; rep answered, customer followed up again ('I wasn't sure if I'd be able to wrap the shelves...'), rep clarified again until resolved - genuine two-layer follow-through.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'It will always be prorated in fifteen minute increments'; 'the less time we take, the less money you end up spending.'

top_strength: Thorough, patient handling of a price-comparison-heavy customer across multiple branches without losing composure or the sale.
coaching_note: Customer initiated the booking ('I'd like to move forward with it, please') rather than the rep asking for it - practice proactively asking for the close instead of waiting for the customer to volunteer it.
